inputs.selection: Exactly one of wavs or texts must be supplied; both/neither raises AssertionError.

wavs.constraints: Caller supplies nonempty finite mono waveforms on the model device.

audio.native_pooling: Each clip latent is L2-normalized by get_audio_latents; arithmetic mean across every clip per waveform.

text.native_pooling: XLM-R token states pass through the additional text transformer, arithmetic mean over its complete token axis, then latent projection and L2 normalization. Native mean includes padded positions.

similarity.semantics: Dot product with no softmax, calibration, or additional normalization. Vector/vector produces a scalar; matrix/vector produces one score per row. Audio clip means need not be unit vectors.

audio_segmentation.native_policy: Consecutive complete clips. Append the start of the waveform once to any final remainder; there is no repeated extension loop. A very short track can therefore remain shorter than 240000 samples.
audio_segmentation.empty_audio: No native clips; stacking an empty list fails.

text_tokenization.position_capacity: Ordinary XLM-R sequences support at most 512 non-padding positions including special tokens. The additional transformer max_seq_len=1024 does not extend this capacity.

adapter.audio_pooling: Preserve native clips and normalized clip latents; mean all clips; final L2 normalization added by the adapter.
